Basics

Vegetable tomato sauce

Zöldséges paradicsomszósz

6 months+ Sound idea 35 min 6 portions

From 6 months, on very soft pasta or well-cooked beans. It freezes well.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 carrot (chopped)
  • 1 small onion (chopped and cooked soft)
  • 2 tomato (fresh, or canned tomato with no added salt)
  • 1 small sweet pepper (seeds removed)
  • 100 ml water (no salt)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Chop the carrot, onion, tomato, and sweet pepper.
  2. Cook them in the water until the carrot is completely soft.
  3. Blend until smooth, adding no salt.
  4. Thin with a little water if the sauce is stiff.
  5. Cool and freeze in portions for pasta or beans.

Sound idea

Salt is the usual addition and this sauce does not need it.

Cook carrot, onion, tomato, and sweet pepper, then blend them with no salt. Freeze portions to use as a base for pasta and beans.
